name: driver_entry_noop
desc: Driver jump table entry: no-op / stub entry point
details: Entry point 4 in the Sound Blaster driver dispatch table at offset 0014h. Performs a far jump to sb_noop_stub (0823:1070), which consists solely of a far return (retf). Likely serves as an unused or unneeded driver command slot (such as deinitialization or pause/resume) implemented as a no-op.
